title: Implement Brands section variant (brands-logos)
description: Implement a Brands/Partners section showing partner or supplier brand logos in a horizontal scrolling row.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts `{ content: BrandsContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Renders all brand items with logo image or text name fallback
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Create `src/components/shared/brands/BrandsLogos.tsx`, `index.ts`. Implement: optional headline, flex-wrap row of brand items. Each item: logo img (if logoUrl present) or styled text. Grayscale filter on images with hover color. Consistent height (40-60px) for all items.
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify brand logos or names are displayed in a row.
